text: Acknowledged the Landlord's page for rack A07 (both feeds lost).
Customer Site Lead takes command. P1 under both SLAs; two parties involved (Landlord, IT Partner). Joint bridge to follow.
P1: rack A07 (72 GPUs) without power after a breaker was opened during Landlord maintenance. Jobs being rescheduled. No safety impact. Next update 11:30.
Joint bridge open for rack A07.
Landlord chief engineer on the bridge.
IT Partner site manager on the bridge.
B-side tap-off opened in error during A-side retorque under MOP-310. B-side unit failed on reclose; spare being pulled from the Hall A store.
Rack A07 drained by the scheduler; jobs moved. Technician standing by for the handoff under HO-1.
B-side breaker failed on reclose; Landlord replacing it from site spares. Estimated restoration 2:00 p.m. IT Partner standing by to validate.
Replacement tap-off unit on site. Group lockout on the B-side busway section being applied.
No change; standing by.
No change; standing by. Validation plan ready: power on, NVLink acceptance, NCCL all-reduce.
No change; standing by.
Failed unit removed; replacement being installed. Restoration estimate unchanged.
No change; standing by.
Replacement unit installed; torque and insulation checks under way.
No change; standing by.
Checks passed. Removing locks; ready to reclose the B-side tap-off.
Technician heading to Hall A for the handoff.
Restoration declared under HO-1: B-side tap-off closed, rack A07 feed restored.
Power restored at 2:06 p.m. IT Partner validating the rack; return to service expected within an hour.
Restoration confirmed from telemetry: feed in tolerance at rack A07. IT Partner clear to power on.
Rack powered on; rack_power_on passed. NVLink acceptance running.
NVLink acceptance and NCCL all-reduce passed.
Rack A07 returned to service; all 18 nodes back in the scheduler.
Rack A07 back in production at 3:01 p.m. Post-incident review scheduled for September 18.
Bridge closed. Joint post-incident review set for 2026-09-18.
